current_prompt.body:
REQUEST the exact minimum vertex cover of the specified 50-node regular graph where each node i connects to (i+1) mod 50, (i+7) mod 50, and (i+13) mod 50.
NOTE that computing a minimum vertex cover is NP‑hard and that a provably optimal solution may be computationally infeasible for this instance.
ACKNOWLEDGE the computational infeasibility and, if optimal solution cannot be obtained, PROVIDE either a best‑effort heuristic result clearly labeled as NON‑OPTIMAL or a reduced‑size version of the problem with an explanation of the reduction.

current_plan.body:
ACKNOWLEDGE the computational infeasibility of guaranteeing an exact minimum vertex cover for the given 50-node regular graph
IF an exact solution can be obtained within reasonable resources THEN
COMPUTE the exact minimum vertex cover using an exact algorithm
LABEL the result as OPTIMAL
ELSE
APPLY a heuristic algorithm to approximate a vertex cover
LABEL the result as NON-OPTIMAL
ENDIF
IF the heuristic result is produced THEN
PRESENT the heuristic vertex cover set
NOTE that the solution is approximate and may not be minimal
ENDIF
